name: @foliwake/cli
description: The foliwake command without the engine: sign in to a Foliwake server and run its commands there (site status, sync, preview, publish, code deploy, branches, releases, sources, credentials, CI keys), and develop blocks against a remote preview.

account.description: Accounts of this server: CI keys

code.description: Code releases: prepare, release and roll back the site's JS/CSS

credential.description: Credential values the content sources name (stored on the server, never shown)

migration.description: Whole-site rebuilds against new code, released as one

operation.description: Long operations: their state, cancellation and recovery

project.description: This project folder and the site it is linked to

servers.description: The Foliwake servers this computer is signed in to
